beats.label: S1 · Sarah
beats.text: In 2003, a fungal pandemic tears through overnight. Joel flees Austin with brother Tommy and daughter Sarah, but a soldier shoots Sarah dead in his arms.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The founding wound that governs every choice Joel makes about Ellie for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · Smuggling Ellie
beats.text: Twenty years later, Joel smuggles in the Boston QZ. He and Tess take a Firefly job escorting a teenage girl, Ellie, whose bite never turns — she is immune.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the whole premise: Ellie's immunity is the cure, and Joel is the man being paid to deliver her.

beats.label: S1 · Tess's last order
beats.text: At the drop point the Fireflies are dead, and Tess reveals she is bitten. She stays to blow the building and makes Joel finish Ellie's cure mission west.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Binds Joel to the mission by promise rather than pay — the reason he keeps going past every off-ramp.

beats.label: S1 · Bill and Frank
beats.text: Joel takes Ellie to his allies Bill and Frank in Lincoln, only to find them dead by choice. He inherits their truck and commits to seeing Ellie through.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bill's letter and Frank's death model the love-and-protect posture Joel adopts toward Ellie for the rest of the road.

beats.label: S1 · Jackson
beats.text: In Jackson, Joel finds Tommy alive and nearly hands Ellie off, fearing he cannot protect her. Ellie confronts him, and he chooses to be her guardian west.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Tommy, Maria and the Jackson settlement — the home Ellie and Joel return to, and where Season 2 opens.

beats.label: S1 · Baby girl
beats.text: Trapped alone, Ellie kills a cannibal preacher who tried to rape her. Joel finds her broken and calls her 'baby girl,' cementing them as father and daughter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Formalises the father–daughter bond and gives Ellie the first trauma that makes her capable of the killing Season 2 will demand.

beats.label: S1 · The lie
beats.text: At Salt Lake, Joel kills the Fireflies and Marlene to save Ellie from a fatal cure surgery, then lies to her that no cure was possible.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event Season 2 is built on: the massacre creates Abby's revenge, and the lie poisons Joel and Ellie's relationship.

cliffhanger.text: Joel has buried humanity's cure to keep Ellie alive and lied to her face; Ellie has accepted the answer for now. They ride back to Jackson as father and daughter, with every Firefly Joel killed leaving families who don't yet know his name.
questions: How long can Joel's lie hold once Ellie starts testing it?
What will the families of the slaughtered Fireflies do when they find him?
Can Ellie ever settle into a normal life knowing her immunity meant something?

characters.name: Joel Miller
characters.line: A hardened smuggler who lost his daughter on outbreak night and, after escorting Ellie across the country, slaughtered the Fireflies to save her and lied that a cure was impossible.

characters.name: Ellie
characters.line: A teenage girl immune to the infection whose cure mission ended when Joel killed her doctors; she doesn't know he lied and now lives with him in Jackson.

characters.name: Tess
characters.line: Joel's smuggling partner in the Boston QZ who took the Firefly escort job, was bitten at the drop point, and sacrificed herself so Joel would finish it.

characters.name: Tommy
characters.line: Joel's younger brother, who fled Austin with him on outbreak night and has since built a life in the Jackson settlement, where Joel and Ellie find him alive.

characters.name: Marlene
characters.line: The Firefly leader who entrusted Ellie to Joel; at Salt Lake she authorized the fatal surgery to extract a cure and was shot by Joel to keep Ellie alive.

characters.name: Fireflies
characters.line: The militia trying to engineer a cure from Ellie; Joel wiped out their Salt Lake surgical team, effectively ending their shot at a vaccine.

characters.name: Sarah
characters.line: Joel's daughter, shot dead in his arms by a soldier on the first night of the outbreak in Austin — the loss that shaped everything Joel does after.

beats.label: S2 · Five years on
beats.text: In Jackson, Joel and Ellie are estranged; she suspects his cure story is a lie. Joel sees a therapist, Gail, but withholds what he did at the hospital.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the fractured relationship the season will keep circling back to and the therapy room where the truth finally leaks out.

beats.label: S2 · Abby kills Joel
beats.text: Strangers led by Abby track Joel to Jackson as a horde overruns the town. Joel saves Abby in the woods; she reveals he killed her father and beats him to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The engine of the whole season and the payoff for Season 1's massacre: Joel's death and the name Abby.

beats.label: S2 · The road to Seattle
beats.text: With Jackson refusing to strike back, Ellie leaves alone with Dina to hunt Abby's crew in Seattle — the Washington Liberation Front, or WLF.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the season into a revenge quest and puts Ellie into the Seattle war between the WLF and the Seraphites.

beats.label: S2 · Immunity and pregnancy
beats.text: In Seattle Ellie takes a bite to save Dina and reveals she is immune. Dina confesses she is pregnant with Jesse's child and vows to see the revenge through.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two secrets that reshape the mission: Ellie's immunity is now known to Dina, and there is a baby to weigh against every next kill.

beats.label: S2 · Joel's confession
beats.text: A flashback shows that just before his death, Joel confessed the massacre to Ellie. She doubted she could forgive him but pledged to try.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The emotional through-line for everything Ellie does after: she is avenging a man she was in the middle of trying to forgive.

beats.label: S2 · Nora, Owen, Mel
beats.text: Ellie tortures Nora for Abby's hideout, then shoots Owen and accidentally kills his pregnant partner Mel. Her revenge starts to mirror what she came to avenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ellie crosses lines she cannot uncross, breaking the moral case for her hunt and setting up her collapse in the finale.

beats.label: S2 · Ambush at the theater
beats.text: Abby ambushes them at the theater, killing Jesse and wounding Tommy, then holds Ellie at gunpoint. The show cuts three days back to Abby's morning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger and the perspective handoff — Season 3 walks in through Abby's door, not Ellie's.

cliffhanger.text: Ellie's revenge tour has cost Jesse's life, Tommy's wounds and her own conscience, and Abby has her at gunpoint in the theater as a shot rings out. The show then rewinds three days to Abby's morning, signalling a full switch of perspective.
questions: Whose gun fired at the theater, and who did it hit?
Why did Isaac summon Abby, and what does the WLF want next?
Can Ellie and Dina still build a life together after what Ellie has done in Seattle?

characters.name: Ellie
characters.line: Now nineteen and estranged from Joel over his hospital lie, she watched Abby beat him to death and is deep in a Seattle revenge hunt that is starting to horrify her.

characters.name: Abby
characters.line: The daughter of the Firefly surgeon Joel killed; she tracked him to Jackson, executed him in front of Ellie, and has just ambushed Ellie and Jesse at the theater.

characters.name: Joel Miller
characters.line: Living in Jackson and quietly seeing a therapist about what he did at the hospital; killed by Abby in the woods after saving her from the horde.

characters.name: Dina
characters.line: Ellie's girlfriend and partner on the Seattle revenge trip, now pregnant with Jesse's child and committed to seeing the hunt for Abby through.

characters.name: Jesse
characters.line: A Jackson friend and the father of Dina's baby, who followed the pair to Seattle to bring them home and was shot dead by Abby at the theater.

characters.name: Tommy
characters.line: Joel's brother and a Jackson leader who refused to sanction a retaliation strike but joined Ellie in Seattle; wounded by Abby in the theater ambush.
